reviews.text: The staff is awesome.  Myself and my cats have been with them for about 8 years.  Each time we have gone for shots and other issues it always been pleasant. Your babies will be in good hands.

We always took our pet there; her name was Princess. Unfortunately, she died first, then my mother, and my sadness is immense for the loss of my mother. However, I have faith in my God, Jehovah, that He will bring her back in the New World, for that is what we ask for in the Lord's Prayer: that His Kingdom be established, as it is already established in Heaven. Ladies and gentlemen, young people, and children, let us instill in our children the importance of reading the Bible and putting it into practice. Let us worship God with spirit and truth.

Have a wonderful afternoon!
Thank you so much helping my little doggie,, doctor prescribed the right medication and in 2 days my Luna was back in action

Extremely frustrating experience. Even with an appointment, I’ve consistently waited around an hour to actually be seen. What makes it worse is that I’m often already in an exam room, just sitting there waiting for someone to come in.

I understand that veterinary hospitals can get busy, but this has happened repeatedly. It seems like they need more doctors or better scheduling to keep up with the number of patients they’re seeing.

I’ve been contemplating coming back for a while because of these long wait times, and unfortunately, I’ve reached the point where I don’t think I’ll be returning. I expect better if I ever make an appointment for my pet.

We had alot of questions and the vet was so informative and took time to answer everything.  The front office ladies were really nice as well, i would definitely recommend this place.

If I could give a higher rating I would. My cat spilt a candle on herself (I learned my lesson) and I brought her in with no appointment and they triaged her within minutes, took her back to get examined by a vet within 10 minutes, checking for burns or any skin irritation, and gave her back all fixed up. Very friendly staff. I’m still waiting for them to upload the pic they took of my boy PRIME LOL
This Animal Hospital is amazing . Thank you for tending to my boy Zak . Doctor Porter and her staff. I will always go back for all my Zaks needs thanks again , great service.

Dr. Oates is amazing and seems like a really good vet.  She cares about your concerns and explains things very well.   I'm glad I get to see her if my baby's vet isn't available.  Dr. LaBrie is phenomenal.   He takes his time answering all concerns.   He caught something I missed with my dog.  Dr. LaBrie has operated on my baby's eyelid and now it's fine.  He followed up several times to ensure my dog was OK.  The front staff is amazing.   Rachel, Brandon,  and Sam are the most caring and knowledgeable and I have learned a lot from them. All the staff are wonderful and compassionate.   The vet techs are thorough and compassionate as well.

This was my first visit here with my 12 year old cat, Jasper. I was very worried about him scratching all the time with no evidence of ticks or fleas. I thought maybe it was a thyroid condition and that he'd need lab work. The doctor advised we wait and see if the treatment plan worked first, and if he still wasn't better, we'd talk about lab work (which is expensive). It turned out Jasper did get better, so no need for lab work, after all. I could've been taken advantage of while worried about my little boy Jasper, but we weren't. He's no longer scratching, and the hair he lost is growing back in. Also, all the staff were friendly, caring and competent. Thank you Alamo Dog&Cat Hospital!
They were incredibly expensive. Paid $900 for a quick consultation, blood work and a bottle of antibiotic. $900 is way too much.

We brought our dog in after she ate some/all of a braided rope dog toy. We were very concerned since she wasn't eating or drinking, and knew it would probably be a serious fix. We saw Dr. Porter on our "diagnostics" day/initial visit, and had Dr. Nick for surgery the next day. It was an explorative surgery to go find everything throughout her belly, and Dr. Nick might as well be a magician. We were very scared for her surgery with so many uncertainties, but he fixed her right up, and she is now next day eating, drinking and on the way back to her normal self. Pricing is very affordable considering other clinic pricing, and they will work with you for what is within your budget. We look forward to bringing Mimi back, or our other dog, if we have any future medical issues!

So easy to get an appointment when you need it.  The staff was friendly.  The vet, tech and physician were outstanding.  They were kind and took the time to really explain both the situation and her medication to me.
I’ll definitely go back

The place is great, but not the same as several years ago. The employees are friendly, but the atmosphere is business only. I miss the family feel environment of the past. Where they knew your name and most importantly they knew your pet! There are just a few of the past employees around & it gives a great feeling seeing them.

Today my service was fast! Impressed!! In the past I would wait hours even with an appointment.

The staff was great and often asked for any questions I might have. They were very kind and treated my cat with great care and gentleness since he is often very nervous when he is out of the house.

Where do I begin, our hearts are beyond broken. Our beloved Marley had to be put down yesterday June 24,26
We paid for the highest quality fond memories package. What we witnessed was a nightmare we will never forget.
Our appt was at 4pm. We werent seen Till almost past 530. That was the intense waiting part. Then to put a catheter in MARLEY and administer the lethal euthansia solution along with 2 other injections. Just to tell us he still has a heartbeat and I have to take him to the back and administer an injection to his heart because the catheter came out. This will instintly put him down. With tears in our eyes we were in shock. Dr. Copeland then took him back about what seemed like  20 - 30 min he returned with Marley with his eyes wide open and purple tongue. He was gone. He died alone. That was not a fond memory for Marley nor us. Dr. Copeland explained that was the 1st time that had ever happened. We left in shock and heart broken. Well today june 25th I called to speak to a manager or who ever was in charge. Of course she defended her Dr. She apologized.
She did say the catheter did not come out, like the doctor told us. There wasn't enough euthanasia adminstered. Like if that wasn't enough, hurt to the wound our fur baby died alone instead of with us, all the doctor had to do was calculate correctly. Apologies not accepted. I pray they train properly and this doesnt happen to another family who loves their fur baby.  This is my fond memory (NOT) choose wisely before you take your fur baby here.   You claim to be AAHA standard, think again.  Your hospital is far from this standard. To add injury to the wound, we still have to go pick up our fur babies ashes.

Where do I even begin? Giving this place one star feels like far more than they deserve. If I could leave zero, I would. Yesterday 06/24/2026, a piece of our hearts crossed the Rainbow Bridge but not in the peaceful, loving way we had prayed for. We made the heartbreaking decision to let our sweet Marley go because we loved him enough to end his suffering. We trusted this clinic to give him the peaceful goodbye he deserved. Instead, they gave us a memory that will haunt us forever. Dr. Copeland assured us they were taking Marley to the back only to place a catheter, explaining it would make the euthanasia easier and more comfortable. We trusted him. When Marley was brought back into the room, we prepared ourselves to say our final goodbye. The sedative was given but then we were told Marley still had a heartbeat. Dr. Copeland claimed the catheter must have come out and said the only option was to inject the euthanasia medication directly into our dog’s heart. What breaks us is that no one even took the time to check whether the catheter was actually still in place before making that decision. Marley was taken away from us one last time. When he was brought back, our precious boy’s eyes were still open. His tongue had turned purple. There was no dignity in the way he was returned to us. We were simply told, “He went peacefully. He didn’t suffer.” Then today 06/25/2026, we received a phone call that shattered us all over again. We were told the catheter had not come out. The real reason was that Marley had not received enough of the euthanasia solution. Read that again!!!  Instead of taking a moment to verify what had happened and correcting it through the catheter that was still in place, our fur baby was given a direct injection into his heart. A decision that, according to what we were told afterward, may never have been necessary. No family should have to question whether their beloved pet’s final moments were handled with the care and compassion they deserved. We can never get that goodbye back. We will carry this pain for the rest of our lives. Our animals are not just appointments on a schedule or another payment collected. They are family. They deserve kindness, patience and respect until their very last breath. Rest in peace, Marley. I’m sorry your final moments were not what we promised you. I hope you knew, until your very last heartbeat, how deeply you were loved. We love you beyond words and we always will.

Our baby Marley. May be RIP.
We've had him for 10 years. His health had been declining after being diagnosed with diabetes. Alamo has been his vet for some years now but his end of life treatment was horrible. It was not a "Fond memory " (we paid for the fond memory experience) for us as you emphasize in your messages. It was disheartening to us as his family. To see him suffer because he wasn't given enough dose to put him down peacefully. To watch him be taken back to inject him directly to the heart so he can pass instantaneously...by himself. AND then to bring him back with eyes wide open, his purple tongue sticking out..was a memory we will never ever forget. Our baby suffered at your hands. We took him to you to end his life peacefully in our arms...and you took that from us. Shame on you for not being trained properly, for thinking telling us "this is the first time this has happened " is supposed to justify your actions. We trusted in you and your facility to ease our pain just a little, but you caused the opposite. More pain!!
This was an inexcusable experience for our fur baby and our family.
They’re obviously helpful but the wait is waayyy to long especially if I had an appointment set and came early for it.
All the staff were super friendly and helpful, the wait wasn’t long and they were all so sweet to my sick kitty. Thanks to them, she’s feeling better now!

For more than 50 years, Alamo Dog & Cat Hospital has been my trusted veterinary clinic, and I can confidently say that the quality of care they provide is second to none. There have been many times when I've driven 45 minutes to an hour for an appointment because exceptional care for my pets will always outweigh convenience.
One of the greatest comforts for longtime clients like me has been seeing Dr. Mark LaBrie's legacy continue through his son, Dr. Nick LaBrie. Knowing that the clinic remains in such capable, compassionate hands gives me tremendous peace of mind. Every veterinarian at this hospital is outstanding and genuinely cares about the health, happiness, and well-being of your fur babies.
I also want to recognize a staff member who welcomed me today—Brandon or Jordan (please forgive me for not remembering his exact name). From the moment I walked through the door, his kindness, professionalism, and genuine concern for both clients and pets were evident. Watching him interact with everyone who entered the clinic reminded me exactly why I have remained loyal to Alamo Dog & Cat Hospital for over five decades.
The veterinarians, technicians, and front office staff consistently go above and beyond, treating every pet as if they were their own. Trust is earned, and this clinic has earned mine year after year, decade after decade.
If you're looking for a veterinary clinic where compassion, expertise, and genuine care still matter, look no further. Alamo Dog & Cat Hospital comes highly recommended by me and my fur babies, Nelson and Owen. We are grateful for the exceptional care, kindness, and dedication we have received throughout the years and look forward to many more.
Thank you, Alamo Dog & Cat Hospital, for continuing a tradition of excellence and for treating every pet and owner like family.

I received care for my dog and was prescribed medication to take home 2 boxes of 8.5mg  Zenrelia. I then was referred to their pharmacy online to receive my pet's medication by mail. But when it was time to refill my pet's prescription I noticed that I would save a lot more money by getting one box of Zenrelia 15mg, so I placed the order to get the 15mg.  I reached out to the hospital to ensure that I would be able to get a different dose which wasn't much 17mg to 15mg. I was given 2 boxes of 8.5mg when I visited their office that cost me 140.00 compare that to one box of 15mg which would cost me 50.00 online pharmacy. The person answering the phone stated that we were changing the dosage and that we weren't able to get approved with out the doctor's approval in order to receive the medication online. I followed up the next day when the doctor was in and was told that the doctor did not approve the change base by the dog's weight. I was willing to try the 15mg dose on my pet to not only save money but also lower the dose if the medication worked. It appeared to me that they were more interested on make more money then save me money. Mind you my dog was on 16mg of apoquel. 2mg makes a difference on how my dog would react to the change of medication? I've been coming to this hospital since 2008 with different kids (pets). I find it upsetting that they weren't willing to make the change. Buying 2 boxes at a cost of 74.00 dollars each box at their hospital compare that to one box for 50 dollars online for a slightly lower dose. Why wasn't I offered the 15mg during my visit then having me get 2 boxes of 8.5mg?

My dog hurt his back and was in a lot of pain. I initially tried taking him to another vet, but I was extremely dissatisfied with their service. The vet tech barely examined my dog and immediately gave me a quote for X-rays and other testing. When I asked if there were any other options, she said I could speak with the vet, who would come in later to discuss them with me. I ended up waiting for over an hour, and no one came in to check on me, so I decided to leave.
After that experience, I made an appointment at this location, and I could not have been happier with the service I received here. I didn’t have to wait long at all, and the staff kept checking in on me and even apologized for the wait when I hadn’t been waiting very long.
I then met with Vet Nick Labrie, who was the nicest and most patient vet I’ve ever encountered. He thoroughly examined my dog and explained that X-rays wouldn’t be helpful because he could already tell it was a different issue my dog was experiencing. He mentioned that an MRI could be scheduled, but he also acknowledged that an MRI and potential surgery could be very costly. I really appreciated that he immediately offered other treatment options instead of me having to ask.
I truly felt like my dog was in much better hands. He carefully explained the healing process, the medications my dog would be taking, and was very thorough in discussing everything that was going on.
I couldn’t be happier with the service here. This was my first time at this location, but I would absolutely love to make this my regular vet going forward.
Great place

I recently had to make the difficult decision to have my beloved dog euthanized at this clinic. While the staff was generally okay, I was disappointed by a few aspects of the experience. All we got when we called for the fur clippings was that we will receive it in the mail, and they are not sure if they even cut it.. please don't go here 😢  I'm still so sad..

When I take my animals to the clinic as walk-ins, I definitely don't mind the wait. It is worth the care for my animals! My experience was wonderful. Love this place!
This hospital was my dogs saving grace. Wonderful staff and affordable prices. I cannot recommend them enough.
